other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded sequential IDs in submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original ID columns during preprocessing and instead generates a simple sequential range (0 to N-1) for the submission file's 'id' column. If the test set IDs are non-sequential, alphanumeric, or do not start at 0, the submission will be misaligned or invalid.

summary: The agent builds a LightGBM model utilizing text feature extraction (TF-IDF + SVD). However, the solution contains critical data leakage by fitting the text transformers on the combined train and test sets (FM09). Additionally, it discards the dataset's temporal nature in favor of a randomized split (FM05) and incorrectly generates synthetic sequential IDs for the final submission instead of preserving the test set's original IDs.
